items.does: A client sees the organisation's live controlled-document register (status, version, effective and next-review dates, overdue flags), periodic-review list and read-and-understood training compliance, and approves or retires a document with a real Part 11 e-signature (password + second factor, author refused). On the Change control tab they see the live change log, stage counts and links to deviations/CAPAs/validation, and approve a change with an e-signature. Creating, revising, recording training and raising or advancing changes are only possible by asking AnA in chat; the SOP's text cannot be opened, written or read on this surface.

items.label: Quality management plans
items.does: A client lists the organisation's quality-management plans and creates one (name, version, status, description) with a governed reason of at least 8 characters. They can activate, archive or delete a plan, each with a reason written to the ledger in the same transaction, and view a plan's dashboard counts. Nothing in the product lets them add the section gates or CTQ risk factors a plan is made of, so every plan's dashboard reads 0 sections, 0 factors and 'not assessed'. No document workflow applies a plan's gates.
